displayPattern: Amber status LED on a Carrier Infinity 25VNA8 heat pump or 24VNA9 air conditioner. Short flashes, then long flashes. Code 33 is 3 short flashes and 3 long flashes
meaning: Lost inverter communications, the local fault. It is logged after 2 minutes with no communication between the outdoor control (AOC) and the inverter (MOC). It elevates to fault 48 after 3 consecutive failures within 20 minutes, or after 20 minutes of continuous loss of connection. The manual says to refer to fault code 48.
causes: The fault 48 list this row points to: a loose or disconnected harness between AOC plug PL20 and the MOC
diySteps: Count 3 short and 3 long before you pull the disconnect. Code 48 is 4 short and 8 long
For radio or electrical noise, the fault 48 action says the system will try to self-mitigate with repeated start attempts
Technician: verify the harness between AOC PL20 and the MOC. If the harness is good, the manual's action for possible inverter damage is to change the inverter drive
safetyNote: Outdoor units carry line voltage even when the thermostat is off. Switch off the unit's disconnect and breaker before touching anything. Refrigerant, wiring, compressor and control-board work must be done by a licensed HVAC technician.
proAdvice: Call a licensed HVAC technician. Code 33 is the earlier communications fault. Code 48 is the elevated lockout of the same problem.
sourceTitle: Carrier Infinity 25VNA8 heat pump / 24VNA9 air conditioner Service Manual (4SM)
